identity.name: CoWorkingStay
identity.subTag: Designed for those who refuse to choose between future results and today's reality.
identity.mission: We bridge the gap between professional performance and the fundamental human need to live life fully with nature, creating sanctuaries where productivity, unbound freedom and creative clarity enables you to realize your infinite horizon.
uniqueValueProposition: Coworking-first — built for productivity for high-performing people
Proper working environment — work zones for deep focus and collaboration
Privacy by design — quiet spaces, respectful boundaries, uninterrupted focus
Nature-powered performance — nature is part of the system, not a reward
targetMarket: Startup Founders / Startup Teams / Product Builders
Content Creators, Influencers, Vloggers, YouTubers, Podcasters
Couples/Friends on 'work + vacation' (hackathons, strategy planning, team building)
Students on 'study + vacation' (grad students, board reviewers, exam takers)

locations.name: Work 'n Wave
locations.tagline: Work the day. Ride the wave. Live the life.
locations.address: White Beach San Isidro, Puerto Galera, Philippines
locations.description: Experience the lifestyle blend at Work 'n Wave. Located in Puerto Galera, offering a balance of productivity and adventure.

coworking.description: A professional workspace designed to support your output. Whether you need quiet space for deep work or a vibrant space for collaboration, our environment is tailored for individuals and teams.
coworking.conferenceRooms: A small conference/training room is available for strategy planning, training sessions, and/or client calls.
technology: Dual monitors available on select workstations
coworking.disclaimer: Note: Technology and amenities are provided on a best-effort basis and are dependent on external factors such as local ISPs and electricity providers.
coworking.whatToBring: We encourage guests to bring a **noise-cancelling headset** (for focused work and calls), a **spill-proof mug** (required for drinks at work desks), and a **universal travel power adapter** (if required).

accommodation.beds: Two double-size beds (max 4 guests per room)
accommodation.description: Basic but comfortable. Our rooms are intentionally designed to be restful sanctuaries, focused entirely on providing you with proper sleep and recovery after a long day of work or play.

rates.availabilityNote: 1 to 8 rooms bookable per request, subject to availability.

locations.activitiesDescription: Crush a focused work sprint in the morning, then explore Puerto Galera's rich marine life dive sites, go snorkeling over vibrant reefs, island-hop to hidden coves, enjoy a drink at the beach, or simply get your fitness goals on track at the outdoor workout area.
locations.activitiesDisclaimer: Please note: Most outdoor and adventure activities are provided by third-party local operators and are not affiliated with CoWorkingStay.

gettingHere.publicTransport: From Manila: Take a bus to Batangas Port -> Ferry to Balatero Port (Puerto Galera) -> Tricycle to Work 'n Wave.
publicTransportDetails: Bus from Manila to Batangas Port: Available from Metro Manila terminals such as PITX (Parañaque Integrated Terminal Exchange), Buendia / Gil Puyat Terminals (JAM Liner, DLTB), and Cubao Terminals (JAM Liner, ALPS, DLTB).
Ferry from Batangas Port to Balatero Port (Puerto Galera): Departures via Montenegro, Gallerian, and Island Water.
Tricycle from Balatero Port: A 10-15 minute tricycle ride brings you directly to Work 'n Wave at White Beach.
gettingHere.privateTransport: Drive to Batangas Port via SLEX/STAR Tollway.
privateTransportDetails: Batangas Port offers overnight parking for travelers leaving their cars.
If bringing your car, Roll-on/Roll-off (RoRo) ferries are available from Batangas Port to Balatero Port.

lateArrivalAlternative.title: Late Arrival Alternative (via Calapan Port)
lateArrivalAlternative.description: Missed the last boat for Balatero, Puerto Galera? There is an alternative boat going to Calapan Port, followed by an approximately 1.5-hour drive from Calapan to Balatero, Puerto Galera.
lateArrivalAlternative.note: Public transport from Calapan to Puerto Galera is limited from 5:00 PM onwards, but there are options to hire a tricycle or a van privately from Calapan to bring you to Puerto Galera after 5:00 PM.

gettingHere.parkingInfo: Parking at the hotel is extremely limited. Please contact us in advance to check availability if you plan to bring your vehicle.
gettingHere.shippingLines: Montenegro, Gallerian, and Island Water going to Balatero, Puerto Galera.
gettingHere.disclaimer: Schedules and routes are subject to weather conditions and operator changes. We recommend verifying directly with transport operators before your trip.

guidelines: No loud music or karaoke.
Quiet-by-policy in designated areas to respect deep focus. Keep your voice volume down during calls as a courtesy to others.
Coworking etiquette: Proper attire required (no swimwear or top-off in work areas). Observe silence and be mindful.
No food in the coworking space (use designated eating areas). Only spill-proof BYO mugs allowed inside.
Bring a noise-cancelling headset, a spill-proof mug (required for drinks at work desks), and a universal travel power adapter (if required).
Outdoor Mini Gym: Use personal workout headsets for music privately, and bring your own boxing gloves and hand-wraps if using the punching bag.
Be considerate: Do not occupy multiple shared spaces simultaneously.
No parties or heavy drinking inside the premises, especially in shared spaces.
No smoking inside rooms and shared spaces. Please use designated smoking areas.
No gambling inside the premises.
Clean-as-you-go policy applies to all shared areas.
Conserve water (water is supplied from a reserve source).
Conserve electricity to prevent intermittent power interruptions.
No outside visitors allowed.

infoNotes.title: What to Bring
infoNotes.text: For the coworking space, we encourage bringing a noise-cancelling headset, a spill-proof mug (required for drinks at work desks), and a universal travel power adapter (if required). Planning to hit the outdoor mini gym? Pack a workout headset to play your music privately, plus boxing gloves and hand-wraps if you intend to unleash your wrath on the punching bag!

locationPolicies.deposit: 50% deposit required, remaining balance due before check-in.
locationPolicies.cancellation: Strict no-refund policy. Rebookings are allowed if requested at least 48 hours before check-in, subject to room availability.

gettingHere.publicTransport: From Manila: Take a bus to Santa Cruz, Laguna → Jeepney or Tricycle to Cavinti → Local transport to the property.
gettingHere.privateTransport: Drive via SLEX → Calamba exit → through Pagsanjan to Cavinti. Approximately 3-4 hours from Metro Manila.
privateTransportDetails: Free parking available at the property.
Road is fully paved but winding in mountainous sections.
gettingHere.disclaimer: Fares and schedules are estimates and subject to change by the transport operators.
